name: ruflo
description: The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
one_liner: A coordination layer that lets many AI agents work together as a team on one task, remembering what worked before and talking to agents running on other machines.
buyer: A technical team running large, multi-step AI-automated projects (not a single task, but many coordinated ones) who needs their agents to divide work and not duplicate effort.
business_use_cases: A dev shop running big migration or refactor projects spins up a swarm of specialized agents to split the work instead of one agent working serially.
An agency offers 'AI team-in-a-box' automation builds for clients who want multiple coordinated bots (research, drafting, QA) rather than one assistant.
A technical founder uses the terminal dashboard to monitor cost and progress across a fleet of agents working on different parts of a product.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and configuration of multi-agent swarms for companies that want this but lack the time to learn the orchestration layer themselves.

steal_this: Pick one multi-step task you currently do serially with a single agent and run it this weekend as a 3-agent swarm to see if it actually finishes faster.
